study type: Secondary analysis of prospective observational studies
cohort: The study included 305 healthy term neonates delivered by Caesarean section.
finding: Reference ranges (10th-90th centiles) were established for peripheral-muscle regional oxygen saturation (prSO(2)) and peripheral fractional tissue oxygen extraction (pFTOE) during the first 15 minutes after birth in stable term neonates delivered by Caesarean section.
mod_finding: Reference ranges for prSO(2) and pFTOE were specifically established for term neonates delivered by Caesarean section during the immediate transition after birth.
cross-section timing: during the first 15 minutes after birth (immediate transition)
